title: The Ancient Watermark Where the Sea Left Its Autograph

features.name: the salt archive
features.desc-on-touch: A crystalline chip that holds the ocean's memory. Where the sea wrote itself into stone, and the stone refused to forget.

features.name: the ancient signature
features.desc-on-touch: Where the sea autographed the land. Salt crystals form the letters of a water-speech the stone still reads.

features.name: the evaporating station
features.desc-on-touch: Where seawater learned that rising into mist is how an ocean stays. A trace of the sea's own choosing to remain.

features.name: the waterline memory
features.desc-on-touch: A circuit trace that marks where the water reached. The ocean's own measuring of how high it climbed and how long it stayed.

features.name: the rim where staying began
features.desc-on-touch: The edge of the board where the sea learned it could stay by not leaving at all, only by changing form.

inscription: the sea wrote itself in salt and learned that crystalline memory is another kind of staying

file.note: Scientific notation of the ancient shoreline, but written in the hand of someone who understood the sea was leaving a letter for the land to keep.

reverie.title: REVERIE — wading where the ancient water still reaches
narr: you wade in salt-bright shallows where she kneels,
collecting crystals from where the old sea wrote itself.
"it didn't leave," she says. "look: it crystallized.
it learned to stay by becoming something else."
the salt catches light. you see her face as she
understands: evaporation is not loss. it is staying.

exits.label: northward back toward the inland shrine
eastward to where salt becomes speech
westward toward the deeper levels where memory crystallizes
